data.Name: BBA Global Management
data.Concentration: Artificial Intelligence, Marine & Environmental Manegement, Engineering Science & Innovation Management, Global Business, International Business, Marketing, Sustainable Development & Social Responsibility, Luxury Brand Mangement, Corporate Finance, Supply chain, Accounting, E-Commerce & Digital Strategy, Sustainable Innovation, Entrepreneurship & Business Administration .
data.EntryRequirement: Grade 12 with minimum 55% from a recognised institution + admission interview. English subject with minimum 55 marks in Grade 12 is a mandatory requirement.
data.Remarks: Application Fee of € 100 is waived off. If student does not have 55 marks in English subject then he/she must provide IELTS Scorecard with Overall score 6 and no band less than 5.5. Also if the medium of instruction for previous education was other than English, then it is mandatory for the students to provide an IELTS score card. Students from Pakistan must provide an IELTS with minimum 6, or TOEFL with minimum 71, or DET with minimum 105 score. There will be two interview rounds, one VisioTalent followed by that will be a personal interview on skype or whereby. Please find the details about the process in KC's learning resources section. You can guide & prepare the students accordingly. For all the students from Punjab and Haryana, there will be an initial interview which will be conducted by the India admissions team. Once the confirmation will receive by them stating the student is good with English communication skills, we will proceed ahead with the online application. For Vietnam: MOI letter or IELTS/equivalent required.
data.AverageScholarshipRemarks: Students get a 1.5% scholarship by paying the full one-year tuition fee at once; otherwise, they have to email the school after registration (to get an excellence scholarship ranging from €2000 to €4000).

data.Remarks: Application Fee of € 100 is waived off. If student does not have 55 marks in English subject then he/she must provide IELTS Scorecard with Overall score 6 and no band less than 5.5. Also if the medium of instruction for previous education was other than English, then it is mandatory for the students to provide an IELTS score card. Students from Pakistan must provide an IELTS with minimum 6, or TOEFL with minimum 71, or DET with minimum 105 score. There will be two interview rounds, one VisioTalent followed by that will be a personal interview on skype or whereby. Please find the details about the process in KC's learning resources section. You can guide & prepare the students accordingly. For all the students from Punjab and Haryana, there will be an initial interview which will be conducted by the India admissions team. Once the confirmation will receive by them stating the student is good with English communication skills, we will proceed ahead with the online application. For Vietnam: MOI letter or IELTS/equivalent required.
data.AverageScholarshipRemarks: Students get a 1.5% scholarship by paying the full one-year tuition fee at once; otherwise, they have to email the school after registration (to get an excellence scholarship ranging from €2000 to €4000).

data.Remarks: This course is designed for students who have completed secondary school but do not meet the direct entry requirements for the International BBA program. GEM Paris offers guaranteed progression to the International BBA program at GEM Alpine Business School upon successful completion of the IFP. Student needs to pay an application fee of € 98 (non-refundable) after passing the interview. If the medium of instruction for previous education was other than English, then it is mandatory for the students to provide an IELTS score card with overall required score of 4.5. Before submitting the application to the institution, KC team will connect with the student for an initial discussion over a video call through WhatsApp/Google Meet/Teams Meeting.
